test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'SHOUT' is written as 'VLTAA' and 'TOTAL' is written as 'WSYGS'. How will 'WHITE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3be03b8b5e4632a4a980721390df31a67c8bc5e467564f450ae283422d05ee00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'SHOUT' is written as 'VLTAA'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9bdcbd425ad1d37e4f070de74edc3f0bfde0bf478f60ad1f4498846ba439f243.png] 

'TOTAL' is written as 'WSYGS'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11d0057988f06eae483cd4e6489c5437c80d8b2d3e457aad72d4587594dec56d.png] 

Similarly, for 'WHITE'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2243f841f1285d543942368b5e4a8853b28746948fac2c78338eeb40d69eb6e.png] 

So, 'WHITE' will be written as 'ZLNZL'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
